battery.notes: ~80 Wh class. NBC measured ~9.5h WiFi @150nits on the AMD Legion 5 Gen 10 chassis; Ryzen 7 250 similar class. ~1h under load.

offers.name: Lenovo Legion 15.3" WQXGA 165Hz Gaming Laptop,AMD Ryzen 7 250,16GB DDR5,1TB SSD+1TB Docking Station,NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 8GB GDDR7,1-Zone RGB Backlit,Win 11 Pro,Eclipse Black

reviews.quote: Lenovo's Legion 5 15 is a very good mainstream gamer, which does not reveal any major issues in our review. The chassis is functional with sufficient ports, a very comfortable keyboard, as well as very good maintenance options.

professional.note: No pro review found for the 2026 'Legion 15' rebrand (new product, honest disclosure per SHARED-legion5-ips.md); ratings inferred from the NBC AMD Legion 5 Gen 10 chassis review (87%).

praises: AMD + RTX 5060 at $2,699 sale is the efficiency value pick of the 2026 Legion range — best battery of the non-OLED 15" tiers
15.3" WQXGA 165Hz matte IPS: sharp, bright, flicker-free (no PWM) — the anti-OLED comfort choice
AMD chassis keeps USB4 (Intel 5i models lack it, per NBC Gen 10 finding)
Quiet in everyday use — NBC measured only a 'quiet murmur even in Performance' at idle/light loads on this chassis
Dual SODIMM/dual M.2/screwed battery — easy RAM upgrade from the 16GB config
complaints: 16GB RAM at checkout; the 32GB twin is $400 more on sale, a DIY upgrade is far cheaper
RTX 5060 is fine for 1600p with DLSS but not a native-ultra AAA card
IPS contrast/HDR well below OLED siblings; no card reader; speakers mediocre
New 2026 rebrand has almost no long-term user data yet — early-adopter risk on drivers/BIOS
Legion platform threads report warranty friction and occasional fan-bearing grind

standouts: Best battery + lowest sensible price of the 15.3" IPS Legions at the $2,699 sale price
design_philosophy: Lenovo's 2026 simplification drops the '5' suffix: the Legion 15 is the same 15.3" mainstream chassis with current AMD silicon, sold at aggressive BBY pricing. This 16GB/5060 tier is the volume seller — balanced AMD efficiency, full-TGP mid GPU, and the matte 165Hz panel that avoids OLED's flicker and cost.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC AMD Legion 5 15AHP G10 (87%) per SHARED-legion5-oled.md + IPS deltas per SHARED-legion5-ips.md: 500-nit WQXGA IPS -> screen_quality 6.3 / readability_dark 6.8 (no PWM) / readability_bright 7.0; Ryzen 7 250 (Zen5 8c) -> battery 8.0, productivity 7.8; RTX 5060 -> gaming 6.4; 16GB -> -0.5 productivity / -0.3 ai_ml; AMD chassis keeps USB4 -> port_connectivity 7.3. New 2026 product with no dedicated pro review — disclosed. Image URL follows standard BBY CDN pattern, not individually verified.
